routes.name: e-Visa and Visa on Arrival
routes.summary: Apply for a Malawi e-Visa online. Citizens of some countries (Category Two) can get a visa on arrival at designated ports. Category One countries need a visa before travel. The country lists were not readable.

other: Check the Visa Eligibility Wizard on evisa.gov.mw for your passport.

routes.name: Tourist Visa (single entry)
routes.summary: Single entry visa for visits, residence or business, valid 3 months. Costs USD 75.

routes.name: Multiple Entry Visa (6 months)
routes.summary: Multiple entry visa valid 6 months. Costs USD 150.

routes.name: Multiple Entry Visa (12 months)
routes.summary: Multiple entry visa valid 12 months. Costs USD 250.

routes.name: Transit Visa
routes.summary: Single entry transit visa valid 7 days. Costs USD 50.

routes.name: Visitors / Business Visit Permit
routes.summary: Short stay permit for tourism, visiting relatives or business. 30 days, extendable by 60 more days with fees.

other: Fees not listed on the page.

routes.name: Temporary Employment Permit
routes.summary: Issued before entry for specified employment in Malawi. Apply at epermit.gov.mw.

other: Requirements and fees not listed on the page.

routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit
routes.summary: For visitors who used the 90 day maximum but have a legitimate reason to stay longer.

other: Duration, requirements and fees not listed on the page.

routes.name: Student Permit
routes.summary: For study at an approved educational institution in Malawi.

other: Duration, requirements and fees not listed on the page.

routes.name: Business Residence Permit
routes.summary: For the self-employed, partners or owners of a business or profession. Valid 5 years, renewable in 5 year periods. Funds must come from a legal source outside Malawi.

investment.note: Minimum funds from a legal source outside Malawi.

routes.name: Permanent Residence Permit
routes.summary: Permanent residence permit. The qualifying years were not listed on the page.

other: Years of residence and requirements not listed.

routes.name: Naturalization
routes.summary: Naturalization of an alien. Fee USD 20,000. Residence years and test rules were not readable.

other: Residence years and dual citizenship rules not confirmed. See the Dual Citizenship page on immigration.gov.mw.

routes.name: Registration of Spouses
routes.summary: Citizenship registration for spouses. Fee USD 20,000. Conditions were not readable.

routes.name: Registration by Third Generation
routes.summary: Citizenship registration for third generation descendants. Fee USD 700. Conditions were not readable.
